caveat: single-run timings at 100-500 tips vary by more than the difference between adjacent sizes; medians and IQRs are reported, and R3F/MEGA were not timed here, so panel (b) shows scaling rather than a comparison

agreement_arrays.note: per-node OpenRelTime values keyed by canonical clade (sorted taxa joined by '|'), joined at render time with the R3F reference read from data/golden/r3f/*.csv; stored here so the figure renders without importing openreltime

memory_rss_mb.protocol: peak RUSAGE_SELF.ru_maxrss of one fresh interpreter per tree size, same random-tree protocol as the timing benchmark (uniform branch lengths on [0.01, 0.5], seed 20260906)

environment.note: machine and OS identifiers read from the same host with sysctl(1); interpreter and library versions are the values the original timing run wrote to this file
